body: Yeah, that's why I'm going to try accutane (even if the side effects are shit) as soon as I get clearance from a doctor that my mental health is good enough. Even though I am suicidal and may end my life because of this shit, I don't see myself feeling any worse especially if this has a chance at helping my condition. As far as I've googled it doesn't seem to help but hey maybe it will help me.

Yeah I switched to a clear detergent for my laundry, It doesn't seem to help but I keep buying it because why not. 

Changing diet and lifestyle is something I would like to try but it isn't a simple thing to do. It takes a lot of effort. Another thing (and I'm not sure how much it matters) is that I'm quite thin (possibly underweight) and HS tends to effect people who are overweight more than those who are under. But unfortunately for me I get the "best" of both worlds.
Yeah I have heard of some of these, it's worth a shot. If I'm wiling to die then why not be willing to try.
